title: Tripti Dimri, Siddhant Chaturvedi, Mrunal Thakur At Dhadak 2 Screening | Photos
text: Dhadak 2, starring Siddhant Chaturvedi and Tripti Dimri, is releasing in theatres on August 1. The lead pair was joined by several celebrities at the screening, which was held in Mumbai last night. Tripti Dimri and Siddhant Chaturvedi’s film Dhadak 2 will hit theatres tomorrow, August 1. They were joined by several celebrities for a screening held in Mumbai last evening. (Image: Viral Bhayani) Tripti looked lovely, as she was dressed in smart casuals for the screening. (Image: Viral Bhayani) Siddhant was a dapper sight in a black shirt and pants, accessorised with a green jacket. (Image: Viral Bhayani) he actor also took time to pose with his family, who were there to support him. (Image: Viral Bhayani) Mrunal Thakur, dressed in a maroon jumpsuit, was also seen at the screening of Dhadak 2. (Image: Viral Bhayani) Panchayat actress Sanvikaa kept it stylish in a boho-chic white ensemble at the screening. (Image: Viral Bhayani) Saurabh Sachdeva, who was part of the hit film Animal, also attended the screening. (Image: Viral Bhayani) Singer Jonita Gandhi looked pretty in a polka dot mini dress. (Image: Viral Bhayani) Saiyami Kher, who was recently seen in Special Ops, arrived in a smart athleisure set. (Image: Viral Bhayani) Zain Khan Durrani, seen in the recently released Aankhon Ki Gustaakhiyan, looked handsome in black. (Image: Viral Bhayani)
